seoDescription: Most FCPS K–12 students start Aug. 11, 2027, with a tentative last day May 24, 2028. See breaks, workdays, make-up dates, PDF and ICS.
heroSummary: For most FCPS K–12 students, classes begin Wednesday, August 11, 2027. Fall Break is October 4–8, Thanksgiving Break is November 24–26, Winter Break is December 20–31, and Spring Break is April 3–7. Teacher/Staff Work Days follow Fall, Winter and Spring Break, so students return October 12, January 4 and April 11. The tentative last day is Wednesday, May 24, 2028; weather make-up dates may extend the school year.

yearComparisonTitle: What Changes From the FCPS 2026–27 Calendar?
yearComparisonSubtitle: Published differences between the two board-approved Students & Families calendars.

content: The first day is August 11, 2027, compared with August 12, 2026, in the previous school year.
The tentative last day is May 24, 2028, compared with the scheduled last day of May 26, 2027, in 2026–27.
Fall Break shifts one week later, from Sept. 28–Oct. 2 in 2026 to Oct. 4–8 in 2027.
The 2027–28 calendar adds an August 20 Teacher/Staff Work Day with no classes for students.
FCPS lists eight possible weather make-up dates in 2027–28, compared with four in 2026–27. These remain conditional until FCPS designates them as make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: Why are FCPS students out on August 20, 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar labels Friday, August 20 as a Teacher/Staff Work Day with no classes for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Which FCPS dates are possible weather make-up days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists March 17, May 25–26, May 30–31, June 1–2 and June 5 as possible weather make-up days. They are not confirmed school days unless FCPS designates them as make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: Is May 24, 2028, the confirmed last day of school?
calendarFaqs.a: Wednesday, May 24, 2028, is the tentative last day of school. Weather make-up dates may extend the school year.

calendarFaqs.q: Does William Wells Brown Elementary use the same FCPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The district PDF says William Wells Brown Elementary follows a slightly different Promise Academy calendar and begins classes a few days earlier. Families should check the school calendar for exact dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the FCPS 2027–28 ICS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import of confirmed districtwide dates. Check FCPS for later calendar changes and weather make-up decisions.
